set.body: Found by the UI-X6 responsiveness measurement (2026-09-17, docs/EXECUTION_RESPONSIVENESS.md on the X6 branch): Detection.supportFor in detect/src/main/scala/eyes4s/detect/DetectionResult.scala filters every sample for every detected event, so the final detection step costs O(events x samples). Measured on an M3 Max, OpenJDK 25: 60k-sample recordings take 368-502 ms in that one step, 600k samples take 55-81 s. This misses the 100 ms runner responsiveness target on realistic recordings and slows RecordingPlan.run itself. Samples are time-ordered, so locate each event's sample range by binary search (or a single merged sweep over events and samples) to make it O(samples + events log samples). Acceptance: results byte-identical to the current implementation on the existing detection, recording-plan and EyeLink suites; a property test against the current quadratic version as oracle on generated recordings; the X6 harness shows the 60k-sample step under 100 ms.
set.title: Detection support assembly is quadratic in events x samples
